summary: Solid test suite with good coverage of core functionality. Unit tests comprehensively exercise parsing, classification, and reporting across package.json and requirements.txt manifests, with proper mocking of license lookups. Workflow structure tests validate YAML shape and actionlint compliance. Integration tests via `act` are present but incomplete—only 2 cases (both package.json, neither covering denied licenses). Edge cases partially covered: None values and lookup errors tested, but empty manifests and malformed inputs not exercised. Test design is clear with good separation of unit/structural/integration concerns, descriptive names, and proper use of mocks and tmp_path isolation. Minor gaps: run_act_tests.py is not pytest-discoverable (standalone script), fixture file contents not visible for direct inspection, and integration test suite lacks denied-dependency and requirements.txt scenarios. Would reliably catch regressions on main paths and common errors, but might miss some edge cases and cross-manifest behavior.
